newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real ends off, mkt sees new mini-band drop.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real ends off, mkt sees new mini-band drop.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.03 percent to close at 1.0156 to the dollar in the commercial foregin exchange market, with players seeing a new downward adjustment in the real-dollar mini-band on Thursday.
"The market was expecting a change in the mini-band today. Once the Central Bank did not do it today, players are betting on a drop Thursday, perhaps as soon as the market opens," one dealer said.
The current mini-band, between 1.015 and 1.020 per dollar, was set on Friday by the Central Bank.
The real hit 1.0162 per dollar early afternoon, but gained some ground at the end of the day, dealers said.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0206 to the dollar, down 0.03 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real ended flat at 1.034 per greenback.
